diagnostic_intervention: frozen_method uses the same recursive dependency tree and source procedure but cannot rewrite a stored experiment step before sampling. Both recursive modes can use fresh search after stored steps are exhausted. This tests online step rewriting, not later use of newly saved methods.
source_freeze: One recursive source acquisition per chain; all modes and four consumers inherit independent copies of exactly this paid source state. This is a paired continuation intervention, not an end-to-end from-scratch ranking.
transfer_interventions: Structure change replaces the response family by the next member of linear, quadratic, absolute, threshold. Surface change renames the interface, permutes its control positions, and reverses instrument sign while changing its offset. The physical driver and orientation remain fixed. Source acquisition never sees the new surface or replacement family, and consumer knowledge never crosses forks. These are held-out mechanism-by-binding combinations within the public grammar, not structures outside its four response families.
fairness: Identical public controls, measurements, calibrations, finite hypothesis language, source knowledge, observation cap and confirmation threshold. Flat and recursive differ in research organization. Costs constrain research and describe behavior; savings are not a success criterion.
terminal_evaluation: Complete and freeze all consumers in a chain before any blind terminal evaluation. Terminal outcomes never enter research state. Correctness includes fresh confirmation and independent prediction; symbolic equivalence is reported separately and may be unknown for arbitrary programs. correct_law means predictive equivalence within the finite grammar, not exact AST or parameter recovery: opposite orientations of a quadratic are equivalent.
process_outcomes: Resolved child questions and consumed answers establish online dependency execution. Their counts are not evidence of an accuracy advantage. Causal effects require paired action or candidate interventions.
failure_policy: Retain every registered chain and every unsuccessful or errored task. No replacement seeds, post-result filters, or threshold changes.
resources: Report actual task observations and research CPU. The shared source prefix is charged once per four-consumer arm when describing a whole chain.
